==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Started playing League in 2013 when he was 14.
* His ID '''UmTi''' comes from a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MapleStory MapleStory] monster.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pPZSGACf1ls JAG UmTi on Lee Sin in Pro play, Patch 8.4, and the meaning behind "UmTi" | LCK 2018] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* Looks up to [[Score]].
* Outside of League, he likes to watch vtubers and play Genshin Impact, TFT, and Hearthstone
* Can speak English very well.
** He joined the LCK Global analyst desk for the finals match between [[DWG KIA]] and [[Gen.G]] in the [[LCK/2021 Season/Spring Playoffs|LCK 2021 Spring Playoffs]].
=== Individual Awards ===
* LCS 3rd All-Pro Team (2024 Summer)
* CK 1st All-Pro Team (2020 Summer)
